callers.name: Pip
callers.personality: Bouncy, always in a hurry, talks before you finish saying hello.

lines.text: Hi-hi! It's Pip! Are you open? You're open. Great!
Pip here! Quick call, I'm mid-hop.
The [dish], please! To the lily pad by the bridge. You know the one.
[dish]! Hot as you can make it! Okay bye! Wait. Thank you! Okay bye!
Do you deliver to ponds? Asking for me.

choices.text: Only if you bring a towel.
The bridge is as close as we get.

callers.name: Juniper
callers.personality: Sleepy night owl who yawns through every call.

lines.text: Mrrhello. It's Juniper. I just woke up. Is it dinner or breakfast?
Hi... sorry, I'm yawning. It's Juniper.
Could I get the [dish]? The warm kind. All of it is the warm kind. Okay.
Is it raining where you are? It's raining on my windowsill.

choices.text: Stay cozy. The food will warm you up.

callers.name: Barnaby
callers.personality: Big, polite, and always ordering for his whole family.

lines.text: Good evening! Barnaby speaking. Sorry about the noise, the cubs are excited.
Hello, hello! Barnaby here, from the big house up the hill.
We'd love the [dish], please. Extra napkins. Lots of extra napkins.
The [dish], please. It's for sharing. Well. It's meant to be for sharing.
The little one wants to know if the chef has a hat.

choices.reply: She just gasped. You're her hero now.

choices.text: Not yet, but I'm saving up.
choices.reply: Ha! She says to get a red one.

callers.name: Olive
callers.personality: Slow talker who never forgets to say thank you.

lines.text: Hello... dear. It's Olive. Take your time. I always do.
I would like... the [dish]. Please. ...Thank you.
Just the [dish], if it's no trouble. No hurry. Truly.
Is that a new restaurant name I keep hearing? [restaurant]... how lovely.

choices.text: Thank you! We picked it ourselves.

lines.text: Oh! Someone answered. Hi. I'm Nibs. I've never ordered on the phone before.
Hello, is this [restaurant]? It is? Okay. Good. I practiced this.
Could I please have the [dish]? Just one. Unless that's too many. It's not too many, right?
I'd like the [dish], please. I wrote it down so I wouldn't forget. I still almost forgot.
Do I... tip the delivery duck? How much do ducks get?

choices.reply: Oh, phew. I can do a thank-you.
